title: Consultor Comercial - Sondagem no mercado
description:
Modelo de atuação: Flexível – atuação remota com visitas presenciais a clientes conforme necessidade comercial

Contratação: PJ

Olá, esperamos que você esteja bem!

Estamos realizando uma sondagem no mercado para conhecer profissionais com perfil consultivo e hunter, experientes em vendas de serviços de Outsourcing/BodyShop, especialmente voltados ao segmento de Tecnologia da Informação.

O objetivo é identificar talentos com carteira ativa de clientes corporativos e histórico de prospecção estratégica, capazes de gerar novas oportunidades e parcerias comerciais.

Para ter uma visão mais completa, confira os detalhes abaixo:

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida em vendas de serviços de R&S, preferencialmente para posições de tecnologia;
  • Relacionamento ativo com empresas tech ou com alta demanda por profissionais de TI;
  • Perfil hunter, com capacidade de abrir novas contas e conduzir o ciclo comercial completo;
  • Boa comunicação, visão estratégica e habilidade em negociações consultivas.

Desejáveis:

  • Inglês intermediário ou avançado;
  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de RH, hunting ou tech recruitment;
  • Histórico de contratos relevantes (em valor, recorrência ou impacto).

Suas responsabilidades:

  • Realizar prospecção ativa e abertura de novas contas corporativas;
  • Conduzir o ciclo comercial completo, desde a identificação da necessidade até a formalização da proposta;
  • Apresentar o portfólio de soluções de recrutamento e propor modelos adequados a cada cliente;
  • Acompanhar o pós-venda e manter relacionamento contínuo com clientes e decisores;
  • Representar a consultoria em reuniões, eventos e negociações estratégicas.

Esta é uma vaga de mapeamento de mercado.

Se você possui carteira ativa de clientes, perfil empreendedor e experiência em vendas de consultoria de R&S para o segmento de tecnologia, queremos conhecer seu perfil!

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.

Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals

Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust: We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health: We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect: We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability: We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity: We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Engenheiro de instrumentação
description:
Cargo: ENGENHEIRO DE INSTRUMENTAÇÃO E AUTOMOÇÃO

Descrição da posição:

(Vaga preferencial PCD)

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro de Instrumentação e Automação Industrial com sólida experiência em Projetos conceitual, básico e detalhamento de instrumentação pneumática, hidráulica, eletrônica analógica/digital, modernização da instrumentação, automação, para atuar nas áreas da refinaria do Complexo Boaventura da Petrobras.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Projetos de Instrumentação e Automação Industrial;
  • Execução e revisão de documentos de projetos e consolidação de comentários técnicos;
  • Elaboração e consolidação de comentários técnicos em documentação emitida pela equipe de projeto.

Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Graduado em engenharia eletrônica, elétrica ou automação;
  • Experiência mínima: 6 (seis) anos nas atribuições definidas para sua respectiva especialidade.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Visão analítica e capacidade de propor melhorias.

Diferencial:

  • Vivência em ambientes industriais regulados (petróleo e gás)
  • experiência nos sistemas Petrobrás.

Informações Adicionais:

  • Local: Refinaria do Complexo Boaventura – Itaboraí/RJ
  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Jornada de Trabalho: 40 horas semanais
  • Regime de trabalho: Presencial
  • Salário: R$ R$ 13.340,46

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação: R$ 45,45 por dia útil;
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico: extensivo a família.

Se você se identificou com a vaga, ficaremos felizes em receber seu currículo!

title: Ruby on Rails Developer

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.

Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Profissional de Desenvolvimento Dynamics 365
description:
Código da vaga: 54907

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei Profissional de Desenvolvimento Dynamics 365, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento, configuração e customização do módulo Customer Service no Dynamics 365;
  • Criação e manutenção de soluções utilizando Power Apps e Power Automate;
  • Implementação de automações e fluxos de trabalho seguindo boas práticas;
  • Integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento de componentes personalizados dentro da plataforma Dynamics 365;
  • Apoio no levantamento e entendimento de requisitos técnicos e de negócio;
  • Documentação técnica das soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Colaboração com equipes técnicas e funcionais para garantir entregas de qualidade.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, com foco no módulo Customer Service;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Power Apps e Power Automate;
  • Experiência com IA aplicada a projetos Dynamics 365;
  • Domínio de JavaScript, C#, .NET, Plugins e Custom Workflows no Dynamics 365;
  • Conhecimento em Web Resources, API REST, Dataverse e Azure Functions;
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas eficientes.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificações Microsoft relacionadas ao Dynamics 365 e Power Platform;
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e CI/CD para Dynamics 365.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Sinch is looking for a talented and experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team. In this crucial role, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and supporting data pipelines that connect our various products globally. You will use innovative approaches and technologies, designing data architectures that empower the data domain and provide actionable insights that support key decisions across the organization.

Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Responsibilities

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. • Design and develop end-to-end solutions using Azure services including Azure Container Apps, CosmosDB, Azure Functions, and Azure DevOps.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, security, and UI/UX.

• Hands-on experience in software development and solution architecture.

• Deep expertise in Azure PaaS services, especially CosmosDB, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Functions.

• Excellent presentation and communication skills—able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Familiarity with AI/ML integration and secure cloud architecture is a plus.

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit

Key Responsibilities

• Design and develop end-to-end solutions using Azure services including Azure Container Apps, CosmosDB, Azure Functions, and Azure DevOps.

• Build scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud-native applications.

• Lead technical design sessions and create architecture diagrams and documentation.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, security, and UI/UX.

• Present technical solutions and roadmaps to stakeholders and leadership.

Qualifications

• Hands-on experience in software development and solution architecture.

• Deep expertise in Azure PaaS services, especially CosmosDB, Azure Container Apps, and Azure Functions.

• Strong background in backend development (.NET, C#, or similar), REST APIs, and microservices.

• Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and DevOps practices.

• Excellent presentation and communication skills—able to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Familiarity with AI/ML integration and secure cloud architecture is a plus.

Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a "Top Employer" in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect

Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Especialista em Parcerias Estratégicas
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Especialista em Parcerias para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!

Responsabilidades:

  • Identificar, mapear e prospectar organizações estratégicas (empresas de grande porte, associações e sindicatos).
  • Estruturar e negociar parcerias comerciais com potencial de gerar grande volume de usuários ou receita recorrente.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com BPOs que atendem empresas de grande porte para viabilizar contratos de alto impacto.
  • Representar a Jusfy em eventos estratégicos do setor jurídico, contábil e corporativo.
  • Acompanhar performance das parcerias e propor planos de expansão.

Experiência

  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de parcerias estratégicas, negócios corporativos ou vendas complexas (preferencialmente em SaaS ou tecnologia).
  • Vivência em ambiente de crescimento e ritmo acelerado.
  • Disponibilidade para visitas presenciais a clientes/parceiros.

Diferencial

  • Experiência ou conhecimentos sobre o mercado jurídico.

Habilidades

  • Capacidade de negociação em alto nível e construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de representação em eventos externos.

Ferramentas e dados

  • Experiência com CRM (preferencialmente Hubspot)

Perfil comportamental

  • Proatividade, ownership e foco em solução de problemas
  • Curiosidade e sede por aprendizado contínuo
  • Mentalidade orientada a resultados e crescimento

Modelo de Contratação: PJ

Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;
  • Rotina remota de trabalho;
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.

Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa Partnership Specialist e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se aplique na vaga.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Description

Sinch is a global leader in Communications Platforms as a Service (CPaaS), enabling businesses to engage customers via messaging, voice, video, and more. We are on a mission to help businesses communicate with their customers in real-time, everywhere. In pursuit of this mission, we are seeking a passionate and proactive Marketing Assistant (Affirmative for People with Disabilities) to join our team in Brazil.

The Brazilian market is dynamic and challenging, so this role is vital to our growth. The selected candidate will be the key point of contact for the Public Relations agency, ensuring all actions are closely monitored. Furthermore, will represent the Marketing department in all initiatives and events and will have the opportunity to interact directly with executives and PR professionals to ensure the success of our campaigns.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support and oversee all activities of the Public Relations agency in Brazil, performing as a bridge between Marketing team at Sinch and the Agency.
  • Represent the Marketing department in actions, events and meetings with executives and PRs.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure message consistency and Sinch speech in events.
  • Act as the main point of contact for Public Relations demands, redirecting tasks internally.
  • Ensure smooth communication and alignment of actions between all parties.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience in a marketing or administrative support role is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with design tools (e.g., Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic understanding of social media platforms and email marketing.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Being a Person With Disabilities.

Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future: Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Desired Skills and Experience

Key Responsibilities:

Support and oversee all activities of the Public Relations agency in Brazil, performing as a bridge between Marketing team at Sinch and the Agency.

Represent the Marketing department in actions, events and meetings with executives and PRs.

Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure message consistency and Sinch speech in events.

Act as the main point of contact for Public Relations demands, redirecting tasks internally.

Ensure smooth communication and alignment of actions between all parties.

title: Analista de Projetos Pleno
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Projetos para atuar diretamente no suporte à gestão e execução de projetos, garantindo o acompanhamento eficiente das atividades, controle de entregas e apoio nas rotinas operacionais do time.

O(a) profissional será responsável por organizar informações operacionais, apoiar os gerentes de projeto e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos internos.

Responsabilidades

  • Apoiar na estruturação e acompanhamento de cronogramas de projetos;
  • Realizar o controle e atualização de timesheets da equipe;
  • Monitorar indicadores e gerar dashboards de performance (Power BI, Excel, etc.);
  • Auxiliar na identificação, registro e mitigação de riscos;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de gestão como JIRA, Microsoft Planner e outras plataformas colaborativas;
  • Consolidar informações operacionais e preparar relatórios para reuniões de status;
  • Apoiar a comunicação entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia em operações ou gestão de projetos;
  • Conhecimento prático em JIRA, Microsoft Planner, Power BI ou Excel (dashboards);
  • Familiaridade com gestão de riscos e controle de tempo (timesheet);
  • Boa capacidade de organização, comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Desejável conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Inglês e espanhol desejáveis para interação com times e stakeholders internacionais.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Senior
description:
Estamos buscando um talento para a posição de DESENVOLVEDOR JAVA SENIOR

A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 15 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 8.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.

Obrigatório:

Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de TI; ou conclusão de qualquer curso de nível superior acompanhado de certificado de curso de pós-graduação na área de TI

Experiência exercendo atividades como desenvolvedores de aplicações Java EE 6+.

Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações para pelo menos um dos servidores:

• Apache Tomcat;

• JBoss/Wildfly;

• Open Liberty;

• WebSphere Application Server Liberty;

• WebSphere Application Server versão 8 ou superior.

Certificação CSD - Certified Scrum Developer.

Experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos baseados em Metodologia Ágil, adotando requisitos ágeis e histórias do usuário.

Experiência na técnica Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) usando Cucumber ou equivalente.

Experiência em análise e tunning de performance de aplicações em servidores WebSphere Application Server.

Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizem portlets, JSF (Primefaces) ou React.

Experiência na construção de aplicações que possuam características como:

• uso intensivo de dados, balanceamento de carga e/ou clusterização;

• chamadas assíncronas e troca de mensagens;

• uso de serviços web SOAP e REST.

Experiência no uso das seguintes ferramentas IBM DB2, MS SQL Server, IBM Websphere MQ, Apache Maven e Gradle.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Pleno (Java com exp. em Cloud)
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent?

Conhecimento técnico:

  • Levantamento e Análise de Requisitos;
  • Modelagem de Dados; Conhecimento em Modelagem UML e/ou Análise Estruturada;
  • Conhecer Linguagem de Programação Java; Conhecer Banco de Dados (Ex.: SQL, DB2, Oracle, SyBase);
  • Desenvolvimento micro serviços Java, usando Liberty+JAX-RS ou Springboot;
  • Conhecer design patterns de integração, composição e comunicação de micro serviços (eventos, filas);
  • Experiência em Log/trace (ELK/Dynatrace) Conhecimento de APIs/Swagger, Banco de dados oracle e Mongo DB;
  • Bons conhecimentos de CSS, HTML, APIs;
  • Framework JSF;
  • JavaScript/JQuery.

Responsabilidades

  • Colaborar com a equipe para criar soluções eficientes, escaláveis e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio;
  • Implementar e aplicar arquitetura hexagonal para garantir a flexibilidade e escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Adotar as melhores práticas de Clean Code, com foco na qualidade e legibilidade do código;
  • Ser capaz de revisar e melhorar o próprio código, antecipando e resolvendo problemas antes que se tornem críticos;
  • Escrever testes unitários com Mockito e garantir boa cobertura de testes.

Formato de Trabalho

Remoto

E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

Assistência médica;

VR e VA flexível;

Gympass e Wellz;

Parceria com o SESC;

Descontos em restaurantes;

Descontos em cursos técnicos e de ensinos superior;

Descontos em escolas e plataformas de idiomas.

E aí, aceita o desafio? Então conclua sua inscrição e #VemSerFoursys! Boa sorte!

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (Angular / .NET / SQL)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Developer with 5+ years of software development experience using Angular, .NET, and SQL to develop analytics dashboard web applications for our industry-leading U.S. client. In this role, you will develop new capabilities in the client's core data product to support its e-commerce service.

Our client is an industry-leading, unified commerce and logistics provider that enables companies with omnichannel commerce capabilities, spanning product discovery to order fulfillment. The company's software, services, and logistics infrastructure serve many of the world's most popular brands, streamlining cross-channel operations and driving more efficient growth. With over 6,000 customers, our client revolutionizes the world of omnichannel commerce.

Responsibilities

  • Build solutions to find actionable insights from data and workflow to act on insights
  • Create APIs and UIs for a web-based analytics dashboard application
  • Deliver high-quality, architecturally sound, extensible code
  • Participate in the architecture, coding, and testing of developed systems
  • Assess requirements, discuss, and debate possible solutions
  • Troubleshoot to find and fix bugs
  • Write unit testing (TDD & BDD) and ensure good code coverage

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written)
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing software with SQL, Angular, .NET/C#
  • 3+ years of AWS or other cloud platform experience
  • Experience writing 500+ line analytics SQL queries
  • Extensive experience with Angular and Typescript
  • Experience with Node.js, especially the Nest.js framework
  • Built a data dashboard with dynamic tables and charts
  • Fluent in Agile/Scrum
  • Demonstrated ability to work both independently and with a team
  • Track record of building professional, high-quality, and on-time software
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment

Desired Experience

  • CI/CD experience with CircleCI, Jenkins, or similar technologies
  • Hands-on experience with Node.js
  • Writing efficient SQL queries for big-data databases, such as Snowflake
  • Experience with container-based systems, such as Docker and AWS ECS
  • Experience with serverless computing, such as AWS Lambda
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and DevOps
  • Data management and analytics experience with dbt, FiveTran, and Looker
  • Experience with e-commerce data or analytics applications

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, learn and grow together!
  • Know your ideas are heard and matter!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with kind, smart, and creative people
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO) per year
  • 8 US holidays, PTO can be used for your local holiday
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: HubSpot Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Operational Excellence

100% Remote | Full-Time | Work with a Global Team

Please only apply if you have proven experience on HubSpot, at admin level.

We're looking for a driven Project Operations Manager to bring order, discipline, and results to our Sales and Marketing teams — and beyond.

Join our award-winning team! Ranked #170 on the Inc. 5000 list and recognized as a Clutch Award-winning agency. Trivium Group is a full-service Amazon agency helping brands scale profitably on Amazon, but this role goes further: you'll be part of the Operations team driving structure and performance across our portfolio of businesses.

If you can turn chaos into clear processes, own the tools that show us exactly how we're performing, and keep fast-moving teams accountable, you're who we're looking for.

TO APPLY FOR THIS POSITION, PLEASE COMPLETE THE FOLLOWING FORM:

Your Mission

Turn chaos into clarity and performance. Start with Sales and Marketing — building processes, clean data, and real accountability — then expand the same discipline across our portfolio of businesses. Your job is to make sure we always know exactly how we're performing, fix what's broken fast, and push what works even further.

What You'll Be Doing

Sales

  • Oversee and improve Sales team performance, tackling underperformance head-on
  • Own HubSpot at an admin level (pipelines, properties, automations, sequences, dashboards) — with executive-grade reporting that makes KPIs and performance crystal clear
  • Implement corrective action plans when off track, and identify growth opportunities when ahead
  • Analyse dips using our in-house AI tools and lead improvement projects to completion
  • Create a Sales Playbook for every role to ensure consistency and efficiency

Marketing

  • Bring strong management and process discipline to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery
  • Own HubSpot at an admin level as well, as mentioned for Sales.

title: "FINOPS/SAP Licensing Analyst #983107 "
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Gerenciar e otimizar custos de nuvem, garantindo eficiência financeira e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Assegurar conformidade com acordos de licenciamento SAP, otimizando o uso de licenças e evitando custos desnecessários.
  • Implementar e gerenciar dashboards e processos que forneçam visibilidade em tempo real sobre a eficiência dos recursos de nuvem e custos associados.
  • Colaborar com equipes de TI e áreas de negócio para promover uma cultura de colaboração interfuncional e responsabilidade financeira.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência em gestão de custos de nuvem e otimização de recursos (FinOps).
  • Conhecimento em SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Microsoft Power BI e Excel avançado.
  • Experiência com sistemas SAP ECC, S/4HANA e SAP HANA (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.
  • Fluência em inglês, tanto escrito quanto falado.
  • Criatividade, inovação e atenção à qualidade do trabalho.
  • Adaptabilidade a prazos apertados e mudanças de prioridade.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Title: VIP Account Manager

Location: Brazil -Remote

************ *Note - PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU HAVE IGAMING EXPERIENCE ******************

Our client, a well-known Brazilian gambling operator, is looking for a motivated VIP Account Manager to assist in managing and growing the VIP customer segment to help and assist the current VIP team in place.

This role will focus on building strong client relationships, supporting engagement strategies, and helping improve the overall VIP experience. It's a great opportunity for someone with account management experience who wants to develop their skills in a dynamic industry.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist in identifying and onboarding new VIP clients through prospecting and networking.
  • Support the management of VIP client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction.
  • Help execute engagement and retention strategies to increase player loyalty.
  • Work closely with senior team members to design and implement and improve VIP incentives, promotions, and personalized offers.
  • Monitor key performance metrics such as betting volume, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention rates, and customer lifetime value (LTV).
  • Assist in preparing reports on VIP performance and account development.
  • Ensure compliance with responsible gaming and company policies.

Skills & Qualifications :

  • Experience in account management, sales, or customer service, preferably in the betting or online gaming industry.
  • A wallet or existing player base would be incredibly valuable and sought after.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build client relationships.
  • Basic knowledge of sports betting and online casino market is a plus.
  • Comfortable working with data and reports to understand customer behavior.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and CRM tools.
  • Ability to work flexible hours when needed.

This role is ideal for someone eager to grow in VIP management, with the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals in the field and business.

title: Field Senior Account Sales Engineer
description:
Company Overview:

Cognex is the world's leading provider of vision systems, software, sensors, and industrial barcode readers used in manufacturing automation. Cognex vision helps companies improve product quality, eliminate production errors, lower manufacturing costs, and exceed consumer expectations for high quality products at an affordable price. Typical applications for machine vision include detecting defects, monitoring production lines, guiding assembly robots, and tracking, sorting and identifying parts.

Cognex serves an international customer base from offices located throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, and through a global network of integration and distribution partners. The company is headquartered close to Boston in Natick, Massachusetts, USA.

Cognex is a financially strong international company with a culture that maintains the fast-paced, creative environment of a startup. Its employees, proudly called "Cognoids," take their work seriously, but don't take themselves seriously. Their 'Work Hard, Play Hard, Move Fast' culture recognizes employees for their innovation, perseverance & hard work in a fun & rewarding environment. Cognex values in-person team collaboration, whilst offering remote workplace flexibility up to two days a week depending on the role.

Essential Functions:

  • Properly forecast and close vision solutions opportunities with End Users, Partners, and OEMs to reach the quota goal.
  • Utilize the Cognex sales process to effectively demonstrate products to customers and winning large strategic opportunities.
  • Follows up on sales leads and schedules customer visits, seeking out large opportunities.
  • Effectively conducts customer visits in a solution sales environment.
  • Collaborate with counterparts from other territories on opportunities that are either integrated or installed in a different territory or where the decision makers do not reside in the Account Manager's territory.
  • Follow up on customer inquiries, understand system requirements, and differentiate the Cognex solution.
  • Assists at trade shows and other marketing events.
  • Coordinate evaluations utilizing the Applications Engineering team.
  • Maintain and continuously update project information in Sales Book.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Proven track record of sales performance in the automation or similar industry.
  • Proven track record of operating in a solutions sales environment.
  • Uses defined sales process to deliver desired results on a consistent basis.
  • PC literate with a working knowledge of MS Windows applications.
  • Ability to travel 40% of the time is required.
  • Ability to work independently is required.

Minimum education and work experience required:

  • Technical Degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Proven sales experience and a good track record for exceeding sales targets is required.
  • Experience in selling technical products to all levels of an organization is required.
  • Experience in selling vision products is also preferred.

title: Audio Transcription Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Audio Transcription Specialist (Language: Portuguese, Location: Portugal)

About The Role:

We are seeking detail-oriented and dedicated professionals with hands-on experience in audio transcription and quality assurance. The ideal candidate will be responsible for accurately converting audio content into written text, maintaining high standards of accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality throughout the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Listen carefully to audio recordings and transcribe them into clear, accurate, and grammatically correct text.
  • Identify and correct transcription errors, ensuring proper spelling, punctuation, and formatting.
  • Handle different accents, speech clarity levels, and background noises with attention to detail.
  • Tag and label transcriptions as per project guidelines.
  • Review, proofread, and edit transcripts for quality, accuracy, and completeness.
  • Follow client-specific formatting and delivery instructions.
  • Work closely with project leads and QA teams to meet daily quality and productivity targets.
  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects.
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks.
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.

  • Maintain confidentiality and data security of all content handled.

Requirements:

  • Proven experience in audio transcription or related linguistic work.
  • Excellent command of English (or other project-specific language) with strong grammar and listening skills.
  • Good typing speed and accuracy with familiarity in transcription tools or software.
  • Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.
  • High attention to detail and ability to follow formatting guidelines strictly.
  • Must have a reliable internet connection, functional laptop/desktop, and good-quality headphones (mandatory).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in AI training, transcription QA, or linguistic data projects.
  • Familiarity with timestamping, labeling, or annotation tasks.
  • Experience working with global transcription platforms or large-scale linguistic projects.
  • Knowledge of speech-to-text software and audio editing tools is an added advantage.

title: Coordenador Contas ME
description:
Prazer, somos a Claro!

Aqui, temos um grande time que faz tudo acontecer! É com o esforço e a dedicação de cada uma de nossas Pessoas que somos hoje referência no que fazemos, atuando unidos no nosso propósito, que é "Conectar para uma vida mais divertida e produtiva".

Somamos todas as tecnologias para criar a melhor e mais completa infraestrutura de conectividade do País. Somos multicampeões confirmado pelo Speedtest como Internet móvel mais rápida e estável e com rede wi-fi mais estável do Brasil, entre tantos outros reconhecimentos. Também somos a 5o marca mais valiosa do Brasil (BrandZ).

Estamos presentes em mais de 4.800 municípios, somando mais de 83 milhões de clientes. Lideramos o saldo de portabilidade há mais de 5 anos.

E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários! Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças (Claro pay) e muito mais! Temos presença aeroespacial (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel) e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio e outros. Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e o ecossistema de inovação, que é o beOn, o hub de inovação da Claro e Embratel.

Sustentabilidade é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro, conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.

E aí, deu match? Vem pra Claro construir o novo com a gente!

Como será o seu dia a dia?

  • Coordenar time de Vendas, garantindo a expansão da carteira de Field Sales
  • Construção e apresentação de relatórios executivos para gerência e diretoria, com resultados e performance de sua coordenação
  • Gerenciar base de clientes PJ, garantindo a expansão e retenção da carteira de Field Sales
  • Gerenciar contas existentes e desenvolvimento de relacionamentos de longo prazo com os clientes, fidelizando o cliente para evitar churn
  • Identificar oportunidades de upselling e cross-selling e apresentação de novas soluções aos clientes a cada visita
  • Atuar como ponto de contato principal para questões e demandas trazidas, monitorando a satisfação do cliente e implementação de estratégias para melhorar a experiência
  • Colaborar outras equipes (suporte técnico, marketing, etc.) para garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.
  • Atualizar registros detalhados no CRM e relatórios regulares de atividades de vendas

O que esperamos de você?

  • Pensa e age a partir das perspectivas dos clientes. Demonstra interesse e curiosidade de conhecer os clientes, seus comportamentos e preferências para atender e superar suas expectativas;
  • Demonstra compromisso permanente em aprender, ensinar e desenvolver, contribuindo para um ambiente descontraído, respeitoso e colaborativo, incentivando a diversidade;
  • É flexível para se desprender de paradigmas e modelos mentais existentes. Busca soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis, para criar vantagens competitivas para o negócio, equilibrando os interesses econômicos, ambientais e sociais.

Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:

  • Graduação preferencialmente em Engenharia, Tecnologia e/ou Administração de empresas
  • Experiência com liderança de times comerciais
  • Experiência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em telecomunicações e soluções digitais
  • Conhecimentos em Produtos e serviços de telecomunicações oferecidos para empresas.
  • Amplo domínio de soluções digitais (ex. CRM e ferramentas de gestão de rotas)
  • Familiaridade com técnicas de gestão de contas e estratégias de fidelização de clientes
  • Pacote office intermediário em Excel

É diferencial:

  • Experiência em atendimento de clientes corporativos, especialmente face to face
  • Entendimento básico de métricas de sucesso do cliente

E por que a escolher a Claro?

Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores!

Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só:

Assistência Médica

Assistência Odontológica

Auxílio para patologias graves

· Benefício Farmácia

· Programa de Apoio Pessoal

· Claro Running

· Vale-Refeição e Alimentação

· Vale-Transporte

· Auxílio Creche/Babá

· Auxílio ao Dependente com Deficiência

· Previdência Privada

· Seguro de Vida

Seguro saúde - Pets

Wellhub

· Combo Colaborador

· Programa de Reconhecimento por tempo de casa

· Jornada Flexível

· Convênios e Parcerias

· E muito mais!

Na nossa empresa, valorizamos um ambiente inclusivo, diverso, ético, colaborativo e harmônico. Não fazemos distinção de gênero, raça, cor, orientação sexual, posição social ou deficiências. Todos e todas são bem-vindos(as)!

title: Sourcer Pleno/Senior - INTERNACIONAL
description:
Estamos em busca de Sourcer Pleno/Sênior para integrar o time de Talent Acquisition com foco em contratação North America e LATAM da AI/R Company, grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Você será responsável por mapear o mercado, gerar listas qualificadas e atuar em parceria com os recrutadores, garantindo uma experiência de candidato fluida e processos mais assertivos.

  • Atuar na identificação, mapeamento e prospecção ativa de talentos para posições técnicas (Desenvolvimento, QA, DevOps, Data, etc.);

  • Criar e manter pipelines de talentos atualizados e segmentados por senioridade, tecnologia e região;
  • Conduzir primeiros contatos com candidatos, apresentando a oportunidade e avaliando o fit inicial;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as informações no ATS e LinkedIn Recruiter;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o(a) Tech Recruiter e a liderança para alinhar perfis e prioridades de busca;
  • Contribuir com relatórios de funil de recrutamento e métricas de conversão;
  • Apoiar ações de employer branding e engajamento de talentos.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência prévia como Sourcer, Talent Researcher ou Recrutador com foco em tecnologia;
  • Vivência com vagas de diferentes países;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de busca e automação (LinkedIn Recruiter, AmazingHiring, SeekOut, HireEZ, etc.);
  • Experiência com buscas booleanas;
  • Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Inglês avançado;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com foco em relacionamento e abordagem personalizada.

A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. title: Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for "Data Engineer" Remote mode,who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

  • Snowflake, DBT, SQL
  • Proficient in English
  • Agile Methodologies;
  • Operational Monitoring: Proactively monitor data jobs and pipelines to ensure smooth execution and timely delivery of datasets. Respond to alerts and resolve issues with minimal downtime.
  • Pipeline Maintenance: Maintain and enhance DBT models and SQL scripts to support evolving business needs and ensure data accuracy.
  • Warehouse Operations: Oversee Snowflake operations including user access, query performance, and resource utilization.
  • Incident Response: Act as a first responder for data job failures, conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive measures.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to support operational data needs and troubleshoot issues.
  • Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks, improve pipeline efficiency, and reduce operational overhead.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Maintain clear documentation of operational procedures, job schedules, and incident logs. Provide regular updates to stakeholders on system health and performance.

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We're inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we're pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We're hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You've shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you'll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You've shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don't just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder's DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You've felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn't seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor

Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela

About Downstream

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.

We're inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we're pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

The Role

We're hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You've shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.

At Downstream, you'll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You've shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don't just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder's DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You've felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn't seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Keeta-Partner Operation Strategy Manager 合作商质量控制策略运营
description:
Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for formulating the partner quality control strategy to ensure that the operational quality of partners meets the standards.

2. Take charge of establishing and optimizing the partner quality evaluation system, designing a hierarchical exit mechanism, and collaborating with frontline teams to promptly replace inferior partners.

3. Coordinate various departments such as frontline teams, assessment and pricing teams, and partner management teams to ensure that the exit process is reasonable and risks are controllable.

Requirements:

1. A bachelor's degree or above, with no restrictions on majors.

2. Candidates with more than 3 years of experience in Platform Governence, business analysis, 3PL management, etc. will be given priority.

3. Strong data analysis and communication - coordination skills are required. Candidates with experience in building incentive systems and scoring systems, as well as those with SQL skills, will be preferred.

4. Relevant work experience in formulating fulfillment and delivery strategies, rider management, etc. is required. Familiarity with fulfillment and delivery management under the crowdsourcing and franchise models is also required.

5. Proficiency in English, which should be used as the working language.

title: Franchise Business Consultant - LATAM
description:
The Franchise Business Consultant – LATAM supports Master Franchise and Direct Franchise partners across Latin America by providing operational guidance, financial coaching, and training to drive performance while ensuring alignment with Gold's Gym global standards. This role requires fluency in Portuguese and English and proficiency in Spanish to effectively collaborate across diverse markets in the region. The FBC conducts regular market visits, virtual consultations, and leads both in-person and online training sessions. This is a remote role based out of the Brasil. Frequent travel throughout Latin America—up to 50% or more—is required.

Responsibilities:

Franchise Support & Coaching

  • Serve as the primary operational liaison for Master Franchise and Direct Franchise owners, offering consultative support on day-to-day operations, financial performance, leadership development, and member experience.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships across culturally and linguistically diverse markets, ensuring business strategies align with Gold's Gym standards while adapting to local market needs.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and annual in-person site visits with each franchise location in the assigned LATAM territory.
  • Provide guidance and resources to drive operational excellence and regional growth.
  • Leverage KPI benchmarks, and digital platforms to monitor and support franchise performance.

Training & Leadership Development

  • Develop and deliver in-person and virtual training sessions in Portuguese (and Spanish where applicable) for franchisees and their teams, focusing on operational efficiency, member experience, and profitability.
  • Facilitate webinars, learning sessions, and peer collaboration forums to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing in the LATAM market.
  • Lead onboarding programs for new franchisees and gym leaders, providing a strong foundation in Gold's Gym systems, standards, and growth strategies.
  • Champion the rollout of corporate initiatives, tools, and new programs, ensuring cultural adaptation and consistent adoption across locations.

Operational Evaluations & Brand Standards

  • Perform standardized gym evaluations, operational audits, and brand assessments.
  • Ensure all LATAM locations remain compliant with system standards, brand guidelines, and operational policies.

Strategic Business & Financial Planning

  • Review and interpret financial reports (P&Ls, balance sheets, KPIs) to identify trends and coach franchisees on strategies for profitability and operational improvement.
  • Assist with strategic planning, forecasting, and staff planning tailored to the LATAM region.

Market Insights & System Collaboration

  • Conduct annual market reviews and monitor competitive activity in each territory.
  • Share benchmarking data, performance insights, and market intelligence with both franchisees and internal teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technology, and development teams to align LATAM field strategies with broader corporate objectives.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Fluency in Portuguese, English and Spanish required.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in franchise operations, business consulting, or multi-unit fitness/hospitality management.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Exercise Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead both in-person and virtual training programs in multiple languages.
  • Strong knowledge of fitness industry operations, financial drivers, and customer experience best practices.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and coaching skills, with a high degree of cultural intelligence.
  • Basic knowledge of gym technology platforms is a plus.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% or more across Latin America and Caribbean, including overnight travel and weekends when necessary.

Preferred Attributes

  • Passion for fitness, health, and wellness.
  • Experience supporting international franchise or multi-unit business models, particularly in Latin America.
  • Strong presence and confidence when leading groups and delivering training in culturally diverse environments.
  • High level of business acumen, adaptability, and emotional intelligence.
  • Familiarity with Gold's Gym tools, systems, or service providers.

title: Analista Treinamento e Desenvolvimento Pleno/Senior
description:
Estamos em busca de Analista de Treinamento e Desenvolvimento Pleno/Sênior para integrar o time de Performance e Cultura da AI/R Company, grupo que reúne empresas como Avenue Code, Invillia e Compass UOL. Essa posição tem como propósito impulsionar o desenvolvimento das pessoas e fortalecer a cultura organizacional em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e orientado a resultados. Você será responsável por desenhar e implementar iniciativas estratégicas de aprendizagem e desenvolvimento, apoiar programas de performance e liderança, e atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio.

Responsabilidades:

  • Mapear e analisar necessidades de treinamento junto às lideranças e áreas de negócio;
  • Planejar, estruturar e executar programas de desenvolvimento técnico, comportamental e de liderança;
  • Desenvolver conteúdos e trilhas de aprendizagem (presenciais, online e híbridos);
  • Gerenciar indicadores e relatórios de eficácia dos programas de T&D;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de gestão de performance, plano de desenvolvimento individual (PDI) e sucessão;
  • Conduzir trilhas de desenvolvimento de carreira
  • Atuar como parceiro(a) estratégico(a) de RH, contribuindo para o fortalecimento da cultura organizacional e do engajamento das equipes.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Formação superior completa em Psicologia, Administração, Recursos Humanos, Pedagogia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia sólida em Treinamento e Desenvolvimento,
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de aprendizagem, gestão por competências e ferramentas de avaliação;
  • Experiência com desenho instrucional e facilitação de treinamentos;
  • Domínio de ferramentas digitais de aprendizagem e plataformas LMS;
  • Habilidade para análise de indicadores e elaboração de planos de ação.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para conversação.

A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.
